---
name: project-stockfolio
description: StockFolio — personal stocks portfolio tracker app, full stack, JS only (no TypeScript)
metadata:
  type: project
---

Multi-user stocks portfolio tracker called **StockFolio**.

**Why:** User wants a personal PWA to track stock holdings from mobile.

**Stack:**
- Client: Vite + Vue 3 (JS, no TS) + PrimeVue + Pinia + Vue Router + D3 + vite-plugin-pwa
- Server: Node.js + Express (JS) + Mongoose + MongoDB Atlas (encrypted at rest)
- Data: `yahoo-finance2` npm package (free, no API key), 5-min cron polling, in-memory quote cache

**Key decisions:**
- JWT in localStorage (Phase 1, swap to httpOnly cookie later)
- Mobile-first, bottom navigation bar, PWA installable
- All D3 charts wrapped as Vue components (not standalone JS)
- D3 charts styled like Yahoo Finance: dark bg (#0f172a), green/red, area chart with crosshair tooltip
- MongoDB Atlas free tier (M0), encryption at rest included

**Structure:**
- `E:\Projects\Portfolio\client` — Vite/Vue frontend
- `E:\Projects\Portfolio\server` — Express backend

**How to apply:** Always write Vue components (not bare JS modules). Keep JS only — no TypeScript. Mobile-first layout with bottom nav.
